# MIPS64, big endian. Compared against `llvm-mc -triple=mips64`.
#
# See mips.txt for the notes on reorder and macro mode; they apply here too.
# This file repeats the 32-bit instruction list, because every one of those
# encodings must be unchanged on a 64-bit target, and then adds the doubleword
# instructions that only exist here.
#
# Deliberate divergence: `$t0`-`$t7` name different registers under the N64 ABI
# ($12-$15 for t0-t3) than under O32 ($8-$15), and llvm-mc's mips64 triple
# defaults to N64. rsasm has no ABI switch and uses the O32 names everywhere,
# so the few lines that used `$t0`-`$t7` are spelled numerically here. `$t8`,
# `$t9` and every other ABI name mean the same register under both.
#
# Deliberate divergence: `la` of a *symbol* builds a 32-bit address here (one
# `lui` plus one `daddiu`), where N64 llvm-mc builds a full 64-bit one out of
# six instructions. Only the constant forms of `la` are compared below.

# ---- doubleword arithmetic ----
dadd $4, $5, $6
daddu $4, $5, $6
dsub $4, $5, $6
dsubu $4, $5, $6
daddi $4, $5, 100
daddi $4, $5, -100
daddiu $4, $5, 100
daddiu $sp, $sp, -32

# ---- doubleword shifts ----
# `dsll` covers 0-31 and `dsll32` adds 32 to what is written, which is how the
# pair spans a 6-bit shift amount through a 5-bit field.
dsll $4, $5, 0
dsll $4, $5, 3
dsll $4, $5, 31
dsrl $4, $5, 3
dsra $4, $5, 3
dsll32 $4, $5, 0
dsll32 $4, $5, 3
dsrl32 $4, $5, 3
dsra32 $4, $5, 3
dsllv $4, $5, $6
dsrlv $4, $5, $6
dsrav $4, $5, $6

# ---- doubleword multiply and divide ----
dmult $4, $5
dmultu $4, $5
ddiv $zero, $4, $5
ddivu $zero, $4, $5

# ---- doubleword loads and stores ----
ld $4, 8($5)
ld $ra, -8($sp)
sd $4, 8($5)
sd $ra, 24($sp)
lwu $4, 8($5)
ldl $4, 8($5)
ldr $4, 8($5)
sdl $4, 8($5)
sdr $4, 8($5)

# ---- 64-bit coprocessor 1 ----
dmfc1 $4, $f0
dmtc1 $4, $f0
cvt.l.s $f0, $f2
cvt.l.d $f0, $f2
cvt.s.l $f0, $f2
cvt.d.l $f0, $f2
trunc.l.s $f0, $f2
round.l.d $f0, $f2

# ---- R-format arithmetic and logic ----
add $1, $2, $3
add $8, $9, $10
add $zero, $at, $v0
add $sp, $fp, $ra
addu $a0, $a1, $a2
addu $30, $29, $28
sub $s0, $s1, $s2
sub $27, $26, $25
subu $v0, $v1, $a0
and $11, $12, $13
or $14, $15, $s0
xor $s1, $s2, $s3
nor $s4, $s5, $s6
slt $s7, $t8, $t9
sltu $k0, $k1, $gp
mul $4, $5, $6
movz $4, $5, $6
movn $4, $5, $6

# ---- shifts ----
sll $1, $2, 0
sll $1, $2, 3
sll $1, $2, 31
srl $3, $4, 1
sra $5, $6, 16
sllv $7, $8, $9
srlv $10, $11, $12
srav $13, $14, $15

# ---- multiply, divide, HI/LO ----
mult $4, $5
multu $6, $7
div $zero, $8, $9
divu $zero, $10, $11
madd $4, $5
maddu $4, $5
msub $4, $5
msubu $4, $5
mfhi $16
mflo $17
mthi $18
mtlo $19

# ---- I-format arithmetic ----
addi $4, $5, 0
addi $4, $5, -1
addi $4, $5, 32767
addi $4, $5, -32768
addiu $a0, $a1, 100
addiu $a0, $a1, -100
addiu $4, $5, 0xffff
slti $4, $5, -1
sltiu $4, $5, 1000
andi $4, $5, 0
andi $4, $5, 0xffff
ori $4, $5, 0x1234
xori $4, $5, 0xabcd
lui $4, 0
lui $4, 0xffff
lui $at, 0x1234

# ---- loads and stores ----
lb $4, 0($5)
lb $4, -1($5)
lbu $4, 1($5)
lh $4, 2($5)
lhu $4, 4($5)
lw $4, 8($5)
lw $4, -8($5)
lw $4, 32767($5)
lw $4, -32768($5)
lwl $4, 3($5)
lwr $4, 0($5)
sb $4, 0($5)
sh $4, 2($5)
sw $4, 4($5)
swl $4, 3($5)
swr $4, 0($5)
lw $8, ($sp)
sw $ra, 28($sp)
ll $4, 8($5)
sc $4, 8($5)

# ---- register-to-register pseudo-instructions ----
nop
move $4, $5
move $a0, $v0
not $4, $5
neg $4, $5
negu $4, $5

# ---- li / la: the one- and two-instruction split ----
li $4, 0
li $4, 1
li $4, -1
li $4, 0x7fff
li $4, 0x8000
li $4, 0xffff
li $4, 0x10000
li $4, 0x12345
li $4, -32768
li $4, -32769
li $4, 0x7fffffff
li $4, -0x80000000
li $4, 0xffff0000
li $4, 0xffffffff
li $a0, 0x1230000
la $4, 0x12345
la $4, 8

# ---- system ----
syscall
syscall 3
break
break 7
break 7, 8
sync
sync 1
eret
teq $4, $5
tne $4, $5
tge $4, $5
tgeu $4, $5
tlt $4, $5
tltu $4, $5
teq $4, $5, 7
tne $4, $5, 1023
mfc0 $4, $12
mtc0 $4, $12
mfc0 $4, $12, 1

# ---- coprocessor 1 ----
mfc1 $4, $f0
mtc1 $4, $f12
lwc1 $f0, 8($4)
ldc1 $f2, 16($sp)
swc1 $f4, 0($5)
sdc1 $f6, 24($sp)
add.s $f0, $f2, $f4
add.d $f0, $f2, $f4
sub.s $f0, $f2, $f4
sub.d $f6, $f8, $f10
mul.s $f0, $f2, $f4
mul.d $f0, $f2, $f4
div.s $f0, $f2, $f4
div.d $f0, $f2, $f4
abs.s $f0, $f2
abs.d $f0, $f2
neg.s $f0, $f2
neg.d $f0, $f2
mov.s $f0, $f2
mov.d $f30, $f28
sqrt.s $f0, $f2
sqrt.d $f0, $f2
cvt.s.d $f0, $f2
cvt.s.w $f0, $f2
cvt.d.s $f0, $f2
cvt.d.w $f0, $f2
cvt.w.s $f0, $f2
cvt.w.d $f0, $f2
trunc.w.s $f0, $f2
trunc.w.d $f0, $f2
round.w.s $f0, $f2
ceil.w.s $f0, $f2
floor.w.s $f0, $f2
c.f.d $f0, $f2
c.un.s $f0, $f2
c.eq.s $f0, $f2
c.eq.d $f0, $f2
c.ueq.s $f0, $f2
c.olt.s $f0, $f2
c.ult.s $f0, $f2
c.ole.s $f0, $f2
c.ule.s $f0, $f2
c.lt.s $f0, $f2
c.lt.d $f0, $f2
c.nge.s $f0, $f2
c.le.s $f0, $f2
c.ngt.s $f0, $f2
